output.reason: The brief makes a convincing case that the interim figures are too uncertain to support pulling the lanes or hiring a guard, so keeping store 14 in the 7 December count is a cheap, well-justified decision that meets the 20 November deadline, but it never explains the cause and leaves Imelda's month-end plan mostly waiting on the count.
